description: Before the fix, an approval-marker'd PR that simultaneously committed `"disableAllHooks": true` to `.claude/settings.json` bypassed the kill-switch check in ci_guard.py: the approval-marker branch short-circuited the kill-switch evaluation, so the same PR that authorized a protected-zone edit also turned the entire local hook surface off. Post-fix, ci_guard's kill-switch check runs unconditionally; HARNESS-UPDATE-APPROVED no longer suppresses it. The kill-switch refusal fires before the approval-marker is even consulted.
fix_module: tools/cc/ci_guard.py (kill-switch check runs before approval-marker evaluation; HARNESS-UPDATE-APPROVED never suppresses kill-switch refusal)
